vb_textbox.text: Out of each pairing of gnome (Purple + Red and Brown + Green), there is one which is more lucrative, leading you to the forest with more mushrooms/points than the other gnome's forest.The difference in points can vary; sometimes the lucrative gnome gives significantly more points, sometimes it gives only one or two more. Sometimes neither gnome in the pairing is particularly lucrative, with both giving roughly the same number of points. There is no way of finding the profitable gnome at first aside from chance, but there is a trend of the lucrative gnome being the same as the last time the pairing appeared. The points gathered from the lucrative gnome will gradually decrease the more it is chosen, until the other gnome gives more points by comparison, and becomes the lucrative gnome. Keep track of, and choose, the lucrative gnome in each pairing, but choose the other gnome once the lucrative gnome begins to yield few points.
